name: Underground LHD Trajectory Planning Benchmark
description: # Underground LHD Trajectory Planning Benchmark v1.0 ## Purpose This release provides the minimum public benchmark needed to evaluate trajectory-planning methods on the same underground LHD occupancy grid and task definitions used in the associated study, **“Topology-Guided Continuous-Curvature Trajectory Planning for Articulated Autonomous Vehicles in Constrained Underground Environments.”** The benchmark is intended for reproducible comparison on a common map, common start/goal tasks, common vehicle/path constraints, and common evaluation definitions. Planner source code is not part of this minimal release. ## Dataset provenance The occupancy grid was constructed from mine-site data collected and processed by the authors within an engineering project. The released file contains only the geometric occupancy information required for trajectory-planning evaluation and is approved for public release. The released occupancy grid is the same geometric map used for the reported experiments. Authors: **Yongchun Liu** (first author) and **Pingan Peng** (corresponding author). License: **CC BY 4.0**. See `LICENSE`. Dataset DOI: **10.5281/zenodo.23292838** (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23292838).
